title: Time Until Next Session
scenario: Calculate the number of days between a player's current login and their next login. Return 'player_id', 'event_date', and 'days_until_next'.
tableSchema: activity (player_id INT, device_id INT, event_date DATE, games_played INT)
hint: Use LEAD() to get the next event_date.
correctQuery: SELECT player_id, event_date, (LEAD(event_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY event_date) - event_date) AS days_until_next FROM activity;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE activity (player_id INT, device_id INT, event_date DATE, games_played INT); INSERT INTO activity VALUES (1, 1, '2026-01-01', 1), (1, 1, '2026-01-05', 1);
